# Strategy in Practice — Course Outline

This course develops a practical toolkit for competitive analysis. We move from
firm-level positioning to industry structure, then to execution.

## Learning objectives

| Objective | Assessed by |
| --- | --- |
| Diagnose an industry's structure | Midterm case |
| Map a firm's value chain | Group project |

## Approach

Each week pairs a reading with a live case discussion. Come prepared: the
pre-reads are short but dense, and cold-calling is the norm.

## Themes

We start with value creation and capture, spend two weeks on industry forces,
and close on the limits of strategic planning under uncertainty.
